meta.name: timeline-report
meta.description: Generate a "Journey Into [Project]" narrative report analyzing a project's entire development history from claude-mem's timeline. Use when asked for a timeline report, project history analysis, development journey, or full project report.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成项目开发历程的叙事报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想从开发时间线生成项目回顾报告
copy.tagline_en: Generate a narrative report of a project's development history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to generate a project retrospective from development timeline

howto.what: 收到请求后,Claude 会从 claude-mem 时间线取出该项目全部开发记录,交给子代理按固定章节分析,生成并保存一份标题为“Journey Into [项目名]”的叙事报告(目标 3000–6000 词)。
howto.when: 当用户要求时间线报告、项目历史分析或开发历程等回顾时触发,如“写一份时间线报告”“Journey into my-app”;需要 claude-mem worker 正在运行、该项目已有记录。

say.text: 写一份这个项目的时间线报告
say.note: 会分析 claude-mem 中当前项目的全部记录。

say.text: 为 tokyo 项目写一份 journey 报告
say.note: 输出的报告标题为 Journey Into tokyo。

say.text: 分析 my-app 的完整开发历史,并保存报告

howto.what_en: When requested, Claude pulls the project's development history from claude-mem's timeline, analyzes it in a subagent with a fixed section template, and saves a narrative report titled Journey Into [project] (aim 3,000–6,000 words).
howto.when_en: Triggers when asked for a timeline report, project history analysis, development journey, or similar. Requires the claude-mem worker to be running and observations to exist for the project.

say_en.text: Write a timeline report for this project.
say_en.note: Analyzes the project in the current directory.

say_en.text: Write a Journey into tokyo report.
say_en.note: Produces a narrative titled Journey Into tokyo.

say_en.text: Analyze my-app's full development history and save the report.
